brief:
Dr Amina Shareef, a researcher of anti-Muslim racism, contends that destruction across Gaza, Iran and Lebanon reflects a broader global system of anti-Muslim racism designed to normalise large-scale violence, according to Middle East Eye. Shareef situates the ongoing conflict within a longer historical pattern of anti-Muslim sentiment that has facilitated mass casualties in the region.

The opinion piece argues that anti-Muslim racism functions systematically to desensitise publics to killing in Muslim-majority areas, framing geopolitical violence through a lens of structural prejudice rather than isolated regional disputes.
